steps.title: Пассив во временах
steps.html:
ВремяФормаПример
Present simpleam / is / are + past participleThe hat is pulled over the head.
Past simplewas / were + past participleFive thousand pillows were shipped.
Present perfecthas / have been + past participle$195,000 has been pledged.
Present continuousis / are being + past participleMore are being manufactured.
Будущее и модальныеwill be / can be / must be + past participleIt can be seen from the road.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
Пассив нужен, когда исполнитель неизвестен, очевиден или не важен. The building was renovated in 2019 — строители здесь не главное.

by добавляется, только если исполнителя стоит назвать: pledged by its backers. В большинстве пассивных предложений by нет вовсе.

Чтобы построить пассив, дополнение активного предложения становится подлежащим: Strangers funded the project → The project was funded.

Глаголы без дополнения не имеют пассива: happen, arrive, seem, rise, go.

steps.title: The crowd will pay for it
steps.html:
Прочитайте один раз. Заметьте, как часто автор не называет исполнителя.

Ali Ganjavian had noticed something obvious: people who travel a lot get very tired, and there is nowhere on a plane or in an airport to sleep properly. What he designed was a padded hat that is pulled over the head and shoulders, with a hole for the mouth. It looks ridiculous. It is called the Ostrich Pillow, and it works.

Twenty years ago the next step would have been a bank loan, a long meeting and a polite no. A new product with no track record is not something banks like to fund, and the designer would have been told to find an investor with cash and a taste for risk. Instead the design was put online, and strangers were asked to pay for it before it existed. More than $195,000 was pledged by its backers. In the first three months of production, five thousand pillows were shipped to fifty-two countries.

This is how crowd-funding works. The idea is presented on a website, a target and a deadline are set, and anyone who likes it can pledge money. If the target is reached the project is funded; if it is not, in most cases nobody is charged at all. Backers are usually given the product itself rather than a share of the company, which is why they are called backers and not investors.

The obvious advantage is that a designer who is short of cash can start without giving away part of the business. The less obvious one is the information. If a thousand strangers will pay for something that has not been manufactured yet, the market has answered a question that no amount of research could settle.

It is not a guarantee. Projects are funded and then never delivered; deadlines are missed by a year; some products are quietly abandoned after the money has been spent. But the Ostrich Pillow was designed, funded, made and shipped without a single bank being involved, and that had not been possible before.

steps.title: Как говорить о том, как что-то делается
Ответьте вслух.
items: Расскажите, как что-то в вашем городе построили, профинансировали или изменили. Три предложения в пассиве.
Поддержали бы вы проект онлайн? При каком условии?
Опишите свою вещь: где сделана, как продаётся, для чего используется?

steps.title: Теперь опишите одним высказыванием. Запишите себя.
steps.sub: Используйте пассив минимум в трёх разных временах.
items: It was built / designed in … , and it is used for … .
It has been … since … , and it is currently being … .

steps.title: Урок 28 пройден
items: Я могу сказать, как что-то делается и финансируется.
Я строю пассив в знакомых мне временах.
